title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Researcher reports export to PowerPoint, PDF, Infographic and Audio Overview
summary: The roadmap facts, administrator paths and preview Copilot Pages API are supported. Microsoft documentation disagrees about Pages storage and quota, Researcher's sovereign-cloud availability and whether general extensibility restrictions affect Researcher; the briefing should report these conflicts rather than give only one answer.

claims.claim: Applying the Copilot Pages policy through Tenant Configuration Management requires the signed-in user to have the AI Administrator role.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the Copilot Pages policy using applyOnce and the documented Copilot resource.
claims.quote:
applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.
POST /admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors
APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change.

claims.claim: The Copilot Pages Tenant Configuration Management API is preview.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta. These resources also support remediation and applyOnce.

claims.claim: The configurationMonitor request uses mode applyOnce to apply the policy rather than merely monitor it.
claims.quote: mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue. Optional; defaults to monitorOnly.

claims.claim: copilotpagesnotebooks is the documented Copilot resource for this policy.
The resource's string value '0' disables the Copilot Pages and Notebooks setting.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy UI allows the Copilot Pages policy to be scoped to all users or a selected group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: Tenant Configuration Management supports the Copilot Pages setting only in tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: TCM operations for this resource fail when the setting is configured in any group-level policy in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: Not configured leaves Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation available, subject to the stated OneDrive exception.
claims.quote: Not configured: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration are available to the users.

claims.claim: Users whose OneDrive creation is disabled cannot create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks regardless of this policy.
claims.quote: If your organization disabled the creation of OneDrive, regardless of the setting noted here, these people in your organization can't create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: A Cloud Policy change can take up to 90 minutes where policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: A Cloud Policy change can take up to 24 hours where no policy configurations previously existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.
